title: Olimpiadaga o'tolmagan qiz 40 yoshda nima boshladi?

scenes.text: 1968 yilda figurali uchuvchi Vera Vang AQSh Olimpiada terma jamoasiga o'tolmadi.
U sportni tashlab, Vogue jurnalida ishladi va taxminan 16 yil moda muharriri bo'ldi.
1989 yilda turmushga chiqqanda o'z to'y ko'ylagini o'zi chizdi.
Taxminan 40 yoshida ishdan ketib, 1990 yilda Nyu-Yorkda kelinlik salonini ochdi.
Bugun Vera Vang nomi dunyodagi eng mashhur kelinlik libosi brendlaridan biri.

description:
Vera Vang 1968 yilda AQSh Olimpiada terma jamoasiga o'tolmagan, keyin Vogue jurnalida va Ralf Loren kompaniyasida ishlagan. Taxminan 40 yoshida ishdan ketib, 1990 yilda Nyu-Yorkda kelinlik liboslari salonini ochgan.

Sizningcha, yangi ishni boshlash uchun kech bo'ladigan yosh bormi? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-22 (via web search summaries; direct page fetch was blocked). Britannica: Vera Wang, https://www.britannica.com/biography/Vera-Wang; Wikipedia: Vera Wang (born 27 Jun 1949; with partner James Stuart did not make the 1968 US Olympic team, 5th in junior pairs at the 1968 US Championships; Vogue from 1971, sources give 15 to 17 years, hence 'taxminan 16'; Ralph Lauren design director from 1987 for about 2 years; resigned at 40 to become an independent bridal designer); Encyclopedia.com: Vera Wang Bridal House Ltd, https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/literature-and-arts/fashion-biographies/vera-wang (opened Sept 1990 at the Carlyle Hotel, New York). Correction: born June 1949 and opened Sept 1990, she was 41 at the opening, so the draft's 'age 40 in 1990' was changed to the hedged 'taxminan 40 yoshida ishdan ketib'.
